engineering_check_policy: Before any flight: both estimated and true endpoint height and settling checks; finite states; ECL valid; aero outside zero; no thrust or tilt saturation. Precheck additionally requires positive normal-mode lambda scaling duration in15-27s. No lambda minimum or duty threshold. No parameter retries.
interval_policy: Half-open windows; tracking800Hz, allocation400Hz, PWM333Hz. Recovery entry requires0.5s continuous satisfaction within27-37s. Report missing if not reached.
phase_policy: Main-window roll and full-amplitude yaw waveforms are shifted5s from the40s protocol; amplitude, frequency, phase relationship and12s disturbance length are unchanged.
tail_policy: Hold altitude37-55s; yaw smoothly stops53-55s. No landing reference or ground-contact model.
model_boundary: Ground-coordinate ascent with existing hover-trim rotor initialization. No arming, spool-up, contact or ground effect model added.
comparison_policy: Identical controller, estimator, nominal B, actuator timing, limits and input realization within each seed. Closed-loop v_h/v_c values can diverge after allocator actions. Engineering15/15Hz shared tuning, not holdout generalization or statistical significance.
failure_policy: One final precheck, then15 formal simulation calls only if precheck passes. Preserve failures and all completed MAT files; never retry or overwrite. DA_NS independently audited using original1e-7rad tolerance, not old1e-7degree logging check.
